property_mix.notable: Bradley Stoke is a planned new town (1990s onwards) with modern suburban growth; high proportion of family homes with uPVC and composite doors.

locksmith_relevant: New-build homes dominate, requiring familiarity with modern multi-point locking systems and smart lock retrofits.
Rapid residential expansion means high demand for emergency lockouts and property access in unfamiliar housing estates.
Detached and semi-detached properties often feature upvc doors; composite door lock repair is a common local call-out.
